brand_new.title: Brand New
brand_new.description: Brand new, unworn, never been resized. Warranty starts from the date shown in the watch certificate.

unworn.title: Unworn
unworn.description: Unworn, previously resized, in pristine condition. Warranty starts from the date shown in the watch certificate.

like_new.title: Like New
like_new.description: Lightly used, possibly showing minor hairline scratches. For older stock, the box may display minor signs of wear, such as missing some protective stickers.

very_mint.title: Very Mint
very_mint.description: Shows minor wear, like faint hairline scratches. Case edges remain sharp. The bracelet or strap may have a slight stretch. Markings and engravings are clear.

mint.title: Mint
mint.description: Shows signs of wear, including scratches, scuffs, or small dents. The bracelet or strap may be stretched. Markings and engravings show wear but remain visible.

good.title: Good
good.description: Shows signs of wear, including scratches, scuffs, or small dents. The bracelet or strap may be heavily stretched. Markings and engravings show wear but remain visible.
